- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The Great Barrier Reef is the world's largest coral reef system, stretching over 2,300 kilometers along the northeast coast of Australia and is home to thousands of species of marine life.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The Southern Alps are a mountain range located in New Zealand's South Island, known for their jagged peaks, glaciers, and stunning alpine scenery.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The Kalahari Desert is a vast, arid region stretching across much of southern Africa, featuring unique wildlife such as the Kalahari lion, meerkat, and black-backed jackal.
